system_name: Gemini-class system at AIST Japan; 3rd-gen roadmap 2026-2027
headline: QuEra Gemini delivered to AIST Japan; $230M raised; 3rd-gen system 2026-2027; fault-tolerance milestones
details: QuEra completed first on-premises installation at AIST (Japan), 260 physical / ~37 logical qubits, operating alongside NVIDIA ABCI-Q supercomputer. $230M+ raised. 2025: demonstrated continuous operation, scalable QEC, magic state distillation, reduced runtime overhead (with Harvard/MIT/Yale). 3rd-gen planned 2026-2027. Massachusetts $16M complex at MGHPCC.
relevance_reason: 37 logical qubits is insufficient for our full MERA, but the fault-tolerance architecture (continuous QEC, magic state distillation) is the platform roadmap we need. 3rd-gen 2026-2027 timeline.
access_path: QuEra research access program; AIST collaboration (Japan); AWS Braket.
